experiment.name: Deduplicated context assembly evaluation

conditions.expanded_context: Retrieved chunks expanded with adjacent chunks from the same document section.
conditions.assembled_context: Expanded contexts deduplicated by chunk ID, exact eligible overlap removed, and one global character budget enforced.

experiment.latency_methodology: One retrieval pass, one expansion pass, and one assembly pass per query, corpus variant, strategy, and budget. Model initialization is excluded. This is not a repeated-trial benchmark.
limitations: The benchmark labels relevant evidence phrases, not all irrelevant passages.
Evidence recall does not measure answer correctness.
Character budgets are not model-token budgets.
Assembly is repeated independently at each budget so document labels and separators consume the actual budget.
Latency is exploratory and is not a repeated-trial reliability measurement.
